target_object.goal: Freeze the exact missing schema-only target now that the F813 candidate support domain is explicit but no lawful source-binding selection/preference schema is exported.

required_fields.name: source_binding_selection_or_preference_rule_target_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must point to the exact F812 source-binding selection/preference-rule target and not silently replace it.

required_fields.name: candidate_source_support_domain_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must point to the exact F813 finite two-support domain and not silently replace either member.

required_fields.name: selection_or_preference_rule_schema
required_fields.hard_limit: Must state how one exact source support is selected, preferred, or proven uniquely bindable on the exported F813 domain.

required_fields.name: domain_member_grade_handling_clause
required_fields.hard_limit: Must keep explicit that one support is current-candidate-only and the other is future-only entry target; no silent grade promotion is allowed.

required_fields.name: nontransfer_boundary_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must block silent reuse of foreign-domain selection templates and probe-local family-order rules.

required_fields.name: selected_source_binding_output_schema
required_fields.hard_limit: Must state what exact selected source-binding object or relation a future schema would output.

required_fields.name: future_route_grade_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must keep this schema at future-route target grade until a real schema is exported.

required_fields.name: hard_limits
required_fields.hard_limit: Must explicitly deny provider-shift success, QCD closure, and ToE closure.

current_honest_reading: The repo now exports the exact candidate support domain for the strict-source Shannon -> alpha_s source-binding route.
But no current export supplies the remaining selection_or_preference_rule_schema on that domain.
F814 therefore freezes the exact narrower schema-only target and keeps actual source binding downstream.
recommended_next_move: Build one narrow probe testing whether any current export can lawfully supply selection_or_preference_rule_schema or domain_member_grade_handling_clause for alpha_s_strict_source_shannon_source_binding_selection_or_preference_rule_schema_target_v1 on the exported F813 support domain without silent domain identification.
